name: @strata-ds/mcp

tools.name: list_projects
tools.description: List publicly available Strata design-system projects. Returns projectId, title, description, snapshotUrls (pre-built CDN links to all token formats), and pagination cursor. Backed by controllers/publicController.js::listPublicProjects via GET /v1/public/projects.

tools.name: get_project
tools.description: Get full details of a single public Strata project, including inline designSystemData (variables array and components map) and snapshotUrls for all token formats. Backed by controllers/publicController.js::getPublicProject via GET /v1/public/projects/:projectId.

projectId.description: The project's unique identifier (shown in the Strata dashboard URL).

tools.name: list_asset_formats
tools.description: List all downloadable snapshot files for a Strata project. Returns filenames and versioned CDN URLs for every token format: strata.json, variables.css, strata.css, tailwind.config.json, variables.scss, tokens.json, tokens.ts, tokens.js, tokens.swift, tokens.dart. Backed by controllers/publicController.js::listPublicProjectAssets via GET /v1/public/projects/:projectId/assets.

tools.name: get_tokens
tools.description: Fetch the raw content of a specific token format file for a Strata project. Reads snapshotUrls from the project record (via GET /v1/public/projects/:projectId) then fetches the file from the per-project snapshotCdnBase (CloudFront). Valid formats: strata.json, variables.css, strata.css, tailwind.config.json, variables.scss, tokens.json, tokens.ts, tokens.js, tokens.swift, tokens.dart.

format.description: The token format filename to fetch.

tools.name: list_variables
tools.description: List design token variables for a Strata project via the sync endpoint. Returns items: each is a design token variable (name, value, type, key, layer). Requires STRATA_SYNC_TOKEN. Backed by controllers/syncController.js::getPublicVariables via GET /v1/sync/:projectId/variables.

tools.name: list_components
tools.description: List component definitions for a Strata project via the sync endpoint. Returns component names, props, and node trees (styles reference token var() values). Requires STRATA_SYNC_TOKEN. Backed by controllers/syncController.js::getPublicComponents via GET /v1/sync/:projectId/components.

tools.name: get_component
tools.description: Get the definition of a single named component from a Strata project. Filters the result of list_components by name (case-insensitive). Returns props and node tree with token var() references. Requires STRATA_SYNC_TOKEN.

tools.name: get_insights
tools.description: Get aggregate design-token drift counts for a Strata project. Returns: computedAt, explicitlySetCount, atDefaultCount, customTokenCount. Requires STRATA_SYNC_TOKEN. Backed by controllers/syncController.js::getPublicInsights via GET /v1/sync/:projectId/insights. Note: explicit token values and AI recommendation messages are omitted from this surface — use the Strata dashboard for full insights.

tools.name: suggest_tokens
tools.description: Return aggregate token drift counts as a proxy for AI token suggestions. The backing AI function (controllers/aiRecommendationsController.js::generateRecommendations) runs internally and has no direct public HTTP route in Track A. Returns public insight counts with a note directing to the Strata dashboard for full recommendations with specific values. Requires STRATA_SYNC_TOKEN.

tools.name: get_baseline_preset
tools.description: Get the full 3-layer Strata baseline token preset (foundation / semantic / component) plus starter component definitions. Optional brand primary hex color previews brand override. No authentication required. Backed by controllers/baselineController.js::getBaselinePreset via GET /v1/baseline/preset.

brandPrimary.description: Optional brand primary hex color, e.g. '#6C3BF5'. Include the leading #.
